decisions.reason: The supplement range builds directly on the firm's established pharmacy consumer-health know-how, so management can read its market signals and refine it, which fits the strategy of broadening the consumer health portfolio.
As a Trivital-line extension close to existing knowledge and pharmacy channels, the skin and hair supplement can be assimilated and improved at low cost, though it is a crowded niche.
Joint health is an established supplement category where the firm's formulation and quality expertise applies directly, and it was moved from a mention to its own page, signalling commitment.
The immune supplement was promoted as the newest innovative product in the line and gained relevance during the pandemic years, making it a well-understood, related offering worth keeping.

Although the generic valsartan is distant from the core and was hit by the 2018 NDMA recall, the firm's in-house development, analytics and quality control give it the capacity to secure clean supply, and the product supports its broad generics range, so it is kept despite substantial risk.

The OTC triptan is distant, but it rests on the firm's pharmaceutical development and regulatory competence and aligns with expanding consumer health, so management keeps it to learn from its early results.
